  Docs 

 Documentation . 

 runward’s documentation, for humans and agents alike: concepts, phases, operation, regulated environments, and the reference generated from the package’s sources of truth (so never stale about the version).

 
     Start  Quickstart  One command, your agent, the gate that verifies.  

     Concepts  The gate & evidence  What the gate verifies, and why it is deterministic.  

     Understand  The six phases  From idea to production, each phase gated on evidence.  

     Operate  From an AI agent  Drive runward end to end, no human at the keyboard.  

     Compliance  Compliance evidence  Evidence about the system you deliver, feeding ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF, the EU AI Act, plus the OSCAL export.  

     Reference  CLI commands  19 commands, generated from the package.  

     Reference  Rule catalog  The 64 craft rules.  

     Decisions  ADR journal  102 structural decisions, dated.
